title: Vault architecture review

turns.text:
Here are my notes on the vault design. Can you check the journal layout for holes?

[attachment: vault-notes.txt]
Journal = header line + encrypted JSONL.
AAD binds vaultId, kind, gen, seq, id, prev.
Compaction rewrites with a new gen; manifest records the gen.
Open question: tail truncation is undetectable without an external anchor.

Two observations. First, binding seq and prev in the AAD closes replay and reordering. Second, your open question is right: keep an external anchor (even a line count in a note) if you care about tail truncation.

I put the layout in an artifact on the right.
Good. I moved to Lisbon in March, so I will ship this from there. Remind me to add the anchor note.
Noted: add an external anchor note for tail truncation. Boa sorte in Lisbon.
